Anthropic_accounting: Amazon 10-Q says Q2 other-income net gain $53.4B (H1 $69.1B) was primarily upward observable-price adjustments to Anthropic nonvoting preferred and reclassification of gains on Anthropic convertible debt converted to preferred in Q1. H1 tax provision included $15.9B discrete expense primarily from Anthropic investment revaluation. 10-Q does not split the total $53.4B among components. Private-company equity investment carrying value, primarily Anthropic and OpenAI, was $122.3B at Jun30 vs $16.2B Dec31; observable changes/impairments go to Level 3 other income.
